question: A body having very high mass is bound to have high ______.
solution:
The correct answer is__** inertia.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A body that has** a very high mass** is bound to have** high inertia.**

 
 
• **The tendency of an object to resist changes in its state of motion varies with mass.**
 
• Mass is that quantity that** is solely dependent upon the inertia of an object.**
 
• The **more inertia **that an **object has, the more mass that it has.**
 
• **A more massive object has a greater tendency to resist changes in its state of motion.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **About Acceleration and Retardation:**

 
 
• **Retardation** is** the opposite of acceleration.**
 
• The body's** velocity might either raise or decrease.**
 
• **Acceleration is the measurement of a change in velocity.**
 
• Acceleration is** stated to be positive when the body's velocity increases.**
 
• The acceleration is** also said to be negative if the velocity decreases.**
 
 
 
• **Velocity** is a **vector quantity** that refers to** "the rate at which an object changes its position."**
